emails.subject: Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund | Pre-IPO & Anchor interest – Hindustan Coca Cola Holdings Ltd
emails.text:
Dear Ganesh Rane,

I am CA Deep Dalal, Fund Manager of Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund. I am writing to you as the Book Running Lead Manager to the proposed IPO of Hindustan Coca Cola Holdings Ltd, whose Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated November 6, 2026 has been filed with SEBI for listing on the Main Board of BSE and NSE.

ABOUT US
Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund is a SEBI-registered Category III Alternative Investment Fund focused on India's primary markets. We invest through Pre-IPO placements, IPO Anchor Investor books, the QIB portion of IPOs and Qualified Institutional Placements (QIPs), working closely with promoters and merchant bankers through the listing journey.

OUR VIEW ON HINDUSTAN COCA COLA HOLDINGS
Hindustan Coca Cola Holdings is the largest Non-Alcoholic Ready To Drink beverage company by revenue operating exclusively in India for the Financial Year 2026, according to the TKC Report. We have studied the DRHP closely and the business fits well with our investment focus.

HOW WE WOULD LIKE TO PARTICIPATE
  1. Pre-IPO round: Should the Company consider a pre-IPO placement ahead of the RHP, we would be keen to participate.
  2. Anchor Investor portion: As a SEBI-registered Category III AIF, we qualify as a QIB and would like to be considered for the anchor book.
  3. QIB portion: We would also look to participate in the QIB portion of the IPO.

FUND PROFILE
View our fund profile (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yQX3TH3nmyqzt6rICyliVYFCP1okKqVv/view?usp=sharing (also attached)

I would be grateful if you could introduce us to the promoters of Hindustan Coca Cola Holdings (The Coca-cola Company, Shyam Sunder Bhartia and Hari Shanker Bhartia) and keep us informed as the pre-IPO and anchor book discussions progress. A short call at your convenience would be much appreciated.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

CA Deep Dalal
Fund Manager, Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund
SEBI-registered Category III AIF
Email: fundmanager@parshwanath.in
WhatsApp: +91 83200 52970
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70690 06298
